title: University of Glasgow
description: The University of Glasgow's official brand toolkit defines University Blue (#011451) as the primary colour, the secondary dark palette Dark purple (#4C2683), Dark pink (#A60367), Dark green (#405D18), Dark blue (#005398) and Dark red (#7D2239), and the secondary light palette Light purple (#A5A1CE), Light pink (#E98BAF), Light green (#81C071), Light blue (#4DBBC6) and Light yellow (#F2D25C).
